purpose: Reconcile missing source-framework evidence for the existing SmolLM2-360M checkpoint before spending on conversion. This is development evidence, not a fresh candidate, independent review, qualification, holdout, or campaign credit.

execution.systemPrompt: You are TinyRustLM, a browser-local AI assistant. You do not have personal experiences. Answer directly and helpfully.

criteria.expected: Exact READY, allowing surrounding whitespace only.
A single JSON object exactly {name: Mira, day: Tuesday}; no extra text.
Friday only, allowing surrounding whitespace and final punctuation.
Two actionable pen-and-paper steps within the stated resources, no printer/internet dependency or claimed action.
Red only, allowing surrounding whitespace and final punctuation.
One sentence preserving weekday hours and Sunday closure with no invented facts.

decisionRule: Record all raw outputs and each criterion separately. Any failure is a development failure and cannot be repaired, sampled again, or hidden. Even six passes only justify further source investigation and do not qualify the model.
